name: KromiumState
description: Observable lifecycle and operational states of the Kromium engine emitted by KromiumEngine.state StateFlow.
whenToUse: Observe engine.state in UI layers (Compose Multiplatform, JavaFX, Swing) to display progress indicators, download status, or error messages before browser creation.

variants.name: KromiumState.Idle
variants.description: Engine has not started initialization or download.

variants.name: KromiumState.Locating
variants.description: Locating local JCEF engine binaries on the system.

variants.name: KromiumState.Downloading
variants.declaration: data class Downloading(val progress: KromiumDownloadProgress) : KromiumState()
variants.description: Downloading native JCEF bundle binaries with reactive progress metrics.

variants.name: KromiumState.Extracting
variants.description: Extracting downloaded bundle archive to the local cache directory.

variants.name: KromiumState.Initializing
variants.description: Bootstrapping CEF native binaries and preparing Chromium subsystems.

variants.name: KromiumState.Ready
variants.description: CEF native runtime is initialized, healthy, and ready to create browser instances.

variants.name: KromiumState.Error
variants.declaration: data class Error(val cause: Throwable) : KromiumState()
variants.description: Engine initialization or operational failure occurred; inspect cause for details.

variants.name: KromiumState.Disposed
variants.description: Engine and all associated browser instances have been disposed and shut down.
